description: Defines structures and classes for managing uplink control-plane context repositories, including context packing/unpacking and storage management.

classes.name: uplink_cplane_context_repository
classes.description: Repository class for managing uplink control-plane contexts, supporting add and get operations with context packing and unpacking.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds a new uplink control-plane context to the repository at a specified slot and eAxC.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves the uplink control-plane context for a specified slot and eAxC.
